summary: Hiker fell down a waterfall in McCoy Gulch while descending the west ridges of Tabeguache Peak, sustaining a serious leg injury; technical rope-and-basket rescue by Chaffee County SAR.
location: McCoy Gulch, west ridges of Tabeguache Peak
responding_agency: Chaffee County SAR South, Chaffee County SAR North, Chaffee County Sheriff/EMS
notes: Patient cleared to travel by personal vehicle to the hospital; CCSAR-S Aug 23 press release. Run 794: merged HotRR corroborating URL.
